sentences.en: The Democrats bought space on commercial television for the campaign.
sentences.zh: 民主党人在商业电视台为竞选购买了播放空间。

sentences.en: Residential rooms are not to be used for commercial purposes.
sentences.zh: 住宅房间不得用于商业用途。

sentences.en: Seven lucky dogs were chosen for the dog food commercial.
sentences.zh: 七只幸运的狗被选中拍摄狗粮广告。

senses.zh: 商业的；营利的；靠广告收入的
